Role Overview

As the Product Manager at CloudKeeper, you will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our real-time Cloud usage optimization and recommendation platforms. You will drive the vision for products within the CloudKeeper Platform Suite, such as Lens, Tuner, Commit, Gen AI, and Check.

Key Responsibilities

• Define the vision and product strategy for CloudKeeper Platform Suite, aligned with overall cloud cost & usage optimization goals.
• Own the product roadmap: prioritize features, enhancements, integrations, and user experience improvements.
• Own end-to-end product lifecycle: concept, PRDs, UX/design, development, launch, and iteration.
• Work with UX/design to craft intuitive workflows for engineering/DevOps users.
• Engage with customers to gather feedback, identify pain points, and validate product direction.
• Drive annual planning, release cycles, and sprint delivery (Agile methodology).
• Ensure appropriate documentation, training materials, and enablement for internal and external teams.

Desired Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field (Masters preferred).
• 5+ years of product management experience in SaaS, preferably in cloud infrastructure, FinOps, or dev tools.
• Experience in B2B / Enterprise SaaS product development is a must.
• Strong understanding of AWS or other public cloud compute/storage/networking footprint.
• Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Figma, Productboard, BI dashboards, PostHog preferred.
• Prior experience in cloud cost optimization or FinOps practices is a strong plus.

What You'll Work On

• Lead development and launch of next-gen recommendation engine enhancements.
• Evolve CloudKeeper's industry-leading Guaranteed Savings model.
• Design conversational, AI-powered experiences for engineers.
• Define and refine metrics around savings impact, adoption, and churn.
• Explore multi-cloud optimization, FinOps governance, and cloud-native developer tools.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to own a high-impact product in the rapidly growing FinOps/cloud cost optimisation space.
• A collaborative, innovative environment with talented teams in engineering, data science, UX, and product.
• The chance to make a measurable difference in cloud cost optimization.

(ref:hirist.tech)

About Us:

HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 800+ leading companies worldwide.Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years.

With a remarkable valuation of $3.1B and an impressive annual recurring revenue exceeding $100M, we experience a robust year-over-year growth of 24%. With a global presence spanning 8+ locations and a recent addition in Poland, we're in the pre-IPO stage, poised for rapid growth. We invite passionate and diverse individuals to join us on this exciting path to becoming a publicly traded company and shape our promising future.

Job Summary:

The Assistant Project Manager is a key contributor to the Project Management Office, responsible for designing, implementing, and sustaining best practices, methodologies, and tools across the organization's project portfolio. This role is highly analytical and process-focused. The ideal candidate brings a practitioner’s mindset - someone who has delivered projects not just supported them - and can translate that experience into building stronger PMO standards and governance practices across the organization.

Skills and Experience Needed:

  • A. Project Management and Delivery

    • Own, drive, and execute select complex internal projects, cross-functional initiatives, and process-improvement programs from initial scoping and business case development through to execution, change management, and formal closure.
    •   Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks and areas of improvement across assigned projects
    • Look at how projects are being run, find inefficient steps, and fix them to help teams deliver work faster and with fewer errors.

    B. Governance and PMO Standards

    • Establish and execute a regular audit cadence for project health, ensuring compliance with PMO frameworks and documentation standards. 
    • Govern the adoption and standardized configuration of PSA tool, ensuring a "single source of truth" for project data.
    • Facilitate Stage-Gate reviews and ensure project stage compliance with governance frameworks.
    • Lead the formal collection and analysis of lessons learned post-project/program and integrate resulting recommendations into the PMO methodology and training materials. 
    • Facilitate the PM Community of Practice (CoP) meetings, enabling knowledge sharing, cross-functional collaboration, and the identification of new best practices from project teams. 

    C. Stakeholder Management

    • Act as a single point of contact for senior stakeholders, external vendors and cross-functional teams on PMO - related matters.
    • Synthesize complex data and risks into clear, concise, and executive-ready dashboards, status reports, and presentations for leadership. 
    • Act as a change agent, leading communication strategies to ensure smooth adoption of new PMO processes, tools, and governance policies across delivery teams.
    • Manage governance cadences with external vendors, ensuring deliverables align with business requirements and organizational quality standards. 

Job Specification:

  • A. Education & Experience 

    • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Project Management, or a related field. 
    • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in a Project Management Office (PMO), PMCoE, or a dedicated process improvement/operational excellence role. 
    • Experience in developing and implementing standard project management methodologies and tools.
    • Prior SaaS experience is a plus.

    B. Certifications (Good to have) 

    • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent (e.g., PRINCE2 Practitioner). 
    • Certification in an Agile framework (e.g., Scrum Master, SAFe). 
    • Certification in process improvement (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt). 

    C. Core Competencies 

    • Project Management Expertise: Hands-on experience managing projects end-to-end using structured methodologies
    • Analytical Thinking: Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive ready recommendations.
    • Tool Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Project Portfolio Management (PPM) software and collaboration tools.
    • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels without direct authority.

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive salary.
  • Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)
  • Equal employment opportunities.
  • Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur.

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

 

About the Role

Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a Manager, Enterprise Partnership to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of advertising, data, commerce, and fintech. You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.

The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

What You’ll Own

Agency Relationship & Business Development

  • Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
  • Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams.
  • Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data-led, commerce-media and performance advertising solutions.
  • Create agency-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
  • Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.

Advertiser & Revenue Development

  • Identify high-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
  • Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
  • Convert agency relationships into active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities.
  • Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
  • Drive penetration across priority categories including BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories.
  • Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.

Consultative & Solution Selling

  • Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
  • Position Razorpay’s transaction-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
  • Develop solutions spanning audience intelligence, transaction-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement.
  • Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
  • Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory-led selling.

Agency GTM

  • Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
  • Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities for agency-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
  • Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
  • Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.

Campaign Success & Account Growth

  • Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
  • Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
  • Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
  • Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
